messages:
Lina (AE): FYI -- Vanguardica CISO called. They put the POC on hold until we provide a concise exec note + network runbook that proves no uncontrolled outbound egress and 90d audit retention. Can we assemble artifacts by Fri EOD?
Ravi (SE): Got it. Clarify: do they require full Private deployment or will static NAT IPs + log retention on Hosted suffice for them to sign off?
Noah (SalesOps): They said preference is Hosted for speed, but their security questionnaire makes Dedicated-like controls desirable. They want explicit acceptance criteria.
Priya (Security): Quick answer: Hosted can provide per-request metadata and exportable logs but retention beyond 31 days needs retention add-on. Blocking arbitrary outbound hosts needs network isolation (Dedicated, Private, or customer-side proxy).
Tom (Infra): We can reserve static NAT IPs for a tenant on Dedicated or on a semi-dedicated Hosted path (we call it "reserved egress"). It'll require INFRA-7932.
Lina (AE): They also asked for an emergency rollback play if allowlist changes cause failures. They need minimal steps they can show execs.
Ravi (SE): I'll draft a short 1-page runbook + a 2-paragraph exec note summarizing risk and recommended option (hosted+retention vs dedicated). Runbook will include example CIDRs and rollback commands.
Noah (SalesOps): Pricing note: Dedicated estimated +30-40% MRR; retention 90d export is a fixed monthly add-on. Need sales approval to disclose numbers. Lina, ok to show both options?
Lina (AE): Yes, show both with clear tradeoffs. If they push for speed, show hosted with retention and a migration path to Dedicated later.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare an acceptance checklist for the CISO: 1) Static NAT IPs reserved and verified 2) Log export validated (sample CSV) 3) Egress test (blocked host attempt recorded) 4) Incident rollback documented.
Tom (Infra): infra-bot, open ticket to reserve NAT IPs and schedule an ops window.
infra-bot: Opened INFRA-7932: Reserve static NAT IPs for tenant-vanguardica and create ACL template. Assigned to infra-scheduling.
Ravi (SE): Draft runbook snippet: ```
Inbound allowlist: 13.52.101.0/24, 34.203.150.0/24
Steps:
- Verify INFRA-7932 reserved IPs
- Customer opens inbound to reserved IPs
- Run egress validation script from service-side to blocked host
- Export logs: /console/logs/export?tenant=vanguardica&range=90d
Rollback:
- Revert ACLs to prior hash abc123
- Switch route to stable-model pool
- Alert infra-oncall
```
Noah (SalesOps): I'll draft the legal-ready memo including short pricing appendix and a recommended acceptance criteria paragraph. ETA 4 hours.
Lina (AE): Important: ask Legal for a short statement on liability for outbound traffic originating from customer-provided inputs during POC. That was a CISO question.
Priya (Security): I'll propose wording: "Redwood provides network-level isolation controls as described; outbound content is subject to customer egress policies and joint validation is required during the POC." Will run by Legal.
Tom (Infra): Tentative timeline: if INFRA-7932 is prioritized today, we can provide reserved IPs by Thu morning. Otherwise Fri EOD.
Lina (AE): Great. Noah, Ravi, Priya please drop final runbook + exec note + INFRA-7932 link in this thread so I can send to their CISO.
Ravi (SE): Will post first draft here in ~2 hours.
Noah (SalesOps): Legal memo draft started. Will attach pricing table once INFRA-7932 is confirmed.
Priya (Security): Posted acceptance checklist and suggested CISO wording.
Lina (AE): Thanks all. This is priority for closing the deal. :pray:
